rubrics.justification: The response reasonably identifies an expanded blastocyst with a visible ICM-like cluster and somewhat sparse TE, but the exact stage/grade is uncertain from this single image and comments such as cytoplasmic debris and moderately thinned zona are somewhat speculative.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior live births, endometrium, male factor context, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis, though some links are stronger than others.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis tied to morphology and patient factors; minor issues include somewhat overconfident quantitative adjustments and speculative interpretation of some risk factors.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based (SET, smoking/alcohol cessation, standard luteal support), but suggestions such as adding estradiol for a thick endometrium, ERA after one failure, broad thrombophilia screening, and routine PGT-A are not strongly guideline-supported in this scenario.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, including lifestyle modification and possible further workup, though a few suggestions are more speculative than standard.
